coverage.details: Applications include exact declared principal reference and revocation mode/duration text. Variants include principal/variant/kind, sorted fields, declared qualified/generic/nullable type spelling, optional flag and exact declaration tokens. Auth rows include transport tokens; validator identity/mode/principal, complete declared setting expression tokens and optional credential slot references/active tokens; claim source/target; resolution principal/authority/active tokens/mappings/inactive failure. No evaluated runtime configuration values.

Tokens fully contained in checked ranges, trivia filtered, offsets omitted; operators and literal byte spelling retained. Transport range contains its full declaration; field range captures exact declaration. Whitespace-only active expression change leaves this facet identical while overall exact source binding may still change. No semantic equivalence or feasibility theorem inferred.

coverage.source: principal_contracts BTreeMaps; semantic/src/lib.rs authentication checks/add_node; semantic/src/typecheck.rs settings checks
coverage.details: Category rows sorted by stable identity, field/settings/mapping keys lexically sorted. Checked source excludes duplicate strategy, validator, mapping target, resolution variant and field declaration; settings uniqueness is type checked. Map collection therefore does not turn invalid duplicates into accepted last-wins facts. Observed CLI duplicate fixtures reject and emit no subject; negative focused mapping duplicate case also passes.

Claim identity is strategy+target; projection identity is strategy+resolution principal+target. A valid source-field change retains the decision identity and exposes exact changed source_field; target change necessarily removes old key/adds new key. Qualified category prefixes avoid collisions with declaration/role facts. Source-change decision behavior exercised; explicit target-retarget scenario not separately executed in this review. General rename-stable identity remains outside scope.

coverage.details: Active enabled==true/false, same-type alternate projection source, declared audience literal and revocation delay changes bind separate exact before/after decisions even with unchanged calls. Migration settings contain config.session_signing_key, owner Service.owner_id and literal non-secret audience; credentials identity/principal/verifier/active/expires/revoked references match source.

coverage.source: checked(project); CLI require_valid_frontend; negative focused and CLI fixtures
coverage.details: Non-Bool active predicate, incompatible Bool→Uuid projection, missing source field and duplicate mapping reject in focused tests. CLI rejects combined auth uniqueness/invariant fixture, typed resolution mismatch/incomplete authority fixture and source-literal secret sink before subject emission. No frontend/parser weakening observed; tests use checked supported grammar.

Helper receives checked AST and reads tokens/references only; never resolves config.secret into a runtime value. Secret settings must be nonnullable secret textual config references; literal secret rejected. Non-secret declared literals are intentionally preserved. The rejected fixture diagnostic echoes a synthetic authored literal, not a live secret; no live credentials/environment values were supplied or collected.
